title: Agent.cmd howto: operational dispatch recipes
desc: T2 howto for agent-cmd: heredoc and --file multiline briefs, model routing, background-for-Opus, and the 3-skill + 5-SPEC brief-guard contract. T1 core = agent-cmd; T3 incidents = agent-cmd-ref.
steps: MULTILINE or special-char brief: use a bash heredoc with a QUOTED delimiter so Agent.ps1 reads stdin verbatim with no tokenization; a single-line ASCII brief may stay a quoted positional arg.

--file path: Agent.cmd --file reads the brief from a UTF-8 file, bypassing the bash to cmd.exe percent-star mangling of newlines, non-ASCII, and shell metachars; this is the canonical path for codex and any multiline brief.

MODEL routing: --model selects haiku/sonnet/opus (Claude), codex/gpt/mini (wkcodex), flash/pro/gemini (agy), ask-gpt/ask-triad (wkappbot ask), or auto (capability+pace router); --family and --tier are the proto tier-selector that overrides --model.

BACKGROUND mandatory for Opus: dispatch with run_in_background true -- a foreground Agent.cmd from Opus is blocked by the Opus-parallel-delegation guard so the Opus process stays idle while agents work (escape WKHARNESS_OPUS_FG=1).

BRIEF-GUARD contract in ONE pass: the prompt MUST contain 3+ wkappbot skill read lines (one MUST be agent-on-load) AND the five LITERAL labels Goal: Files: Approach: Constraints: Exit: -- a parenthetical before the colon (Approach (...):) FAILS the label check.
author: claude
